name: wait_for_work
title: Wait for work
description: Wait for godspeed's next request (lesson turn, background job or knowledge-graph run). Returns a work item, or status "idle" if nothing arrived in time; then call again.

timeout_seconds.description: Seconds to wait (default 45, max 600). Stay under your client's tool timeout: for Codex its tool_timeout_sec (60 unless raised; the godspeed folder's start command sets 620).

lesson_id.description: Stay on this lesson: its turns, plus turns of other lessons nobody waits for, jobs the learner asked for (a page's Ask), and godspeed's own background jobs (file reading, graph building) after a minute while no helper is open, so none get stuck.

full_context.description: Resend whole conversation and instructions, even if seen before (after losing your context).

helper.description: true on every call when you are the helper: second session beside the teacher, started when the user says "Start as the helper". Helper takes godspeed's own background jobs (file reading, graph building, sheets), jobs the learner asked for only when the teacher left them 20 s, and lesson turns only while the teacher tidies its memory.

name: respond
title: Respond to work
description: Answer a work item as a model would: text for the learner (or the task) and/or calls to tools listed in the item. Returns next work item in the same conversation when the app needs you again at once (e.g. tool results), or status "turn_complete".

work_id.description: The workId from wait_for_work or a previous respond.

tool_calls.description: Tool calls, run in order. Only tools listed in the work item.

wait_seconds.description: Seconds to wait for the follow-up (default 30).

name: read_work
title: Read more of a work item
description: Read one page of a long work item, or (full: true) get the whole item again: instructions, every tool, whole conversation, for when you lost track. Item says it has several pages: read all before responding.

work_id.description: The workId of the work item.

full.description: Resend whole item instead of one page (after context compaction, or when you lack the instructions or tools it refers to).

name: list_lessons
title: List lessons
description: List learner's lessons, newest first, each with space and kind (study or homework; older ones teach or practice). total = how many match.

space_id.description: Only this space's lessons (from list_spaces), or "none" for lessons without a space. Omit for all.

name: read_lesson
title: Read a lesson
description: Read one lesson as markdown: everything teacher and learner said, quizzes and answers included. Long lesson comes in pages; each page says which and how many.

name: search_graph
title: Search the knowledge graph
description: Search one space's knowledge graph (each space has its own): facts (propositions) the learner learned and reasoning chains connecting them. No query: most recent facts.

query.description: What to look for, plain words (matched by meaning and keywords).

limit.description: Most facts, and most chains, to return (default 30).

space_id.description: The space id from list_spaces, or "none" for lessons without a space (the default).

name: import_notes
title: Import notes
description: Add notes to a knowledge graph. godspeed turns them into facts in the background; that work arrives through wait_for_work. Returns at once. With space_id the notes become a study file of that space (file from disk: add_space_file).

name.description: File-like name for the notes, e.g. "biology-ch3.md". In a space, re-importing a name replaces notes imported before and rebuilds their facts; in No space it is processed again and adds to that import. A file this tool can't replace (learner's own, or notes from an older version) is refused: pick another name or ask the learner to remove it.

space_id.description: The space id from list_spaces, or "none" for lessons without a space (the default).

name: remember
title: Remember a note
description: Save a short note about the learner. Every agent connecting to godspeed later sees it under "Where you left off", in any folder. Save what the learner tells you outside lessons that matters next time: an exam that's over, what they plan to study next, how they like to learn. One fact per note, max 200 characters. Never passwords or private details. Learner can see and delete notes in Settings → Connection.

space_id.description: Space the note is about, if any (from list_spaces).

name: forget
title: Forget a note
description: Delete a saved note by note_id (from "Where you left off" or remember). Use when a note is out of date or the learner asks.

name: save_rule
title: Save a teaching rule
description: Save a rule on how godspeed's teacher teaches this learner when they state a lasting preference ("use Python for code examples", "shorter answers"). Joins learner's rules in Settings, for every lesson or one space's lessons; applies from next turn. Not for one-off requests or facts about the learner (remember for those). Don't ask first: the godspeed window shows it with Undo and Edit.

rule.description: One line, an instruction to the teacher, e.g. "Use Python for code examples."

space_id.description: Only this space's lessons (from list_spaces). Omit for every lesson.

area.description: For every lesson, the part of teaching it's about: "voice", "teaching" (default), "questions", "facts", "demos" or "files" (files, formatting and code).

name: list_spaces
title: List spaces
description: List learner's spaces, closed ones included, with file and lesson counts.

name: read_space
title: Read a space
description: Read one space: description, file counts per status (pending, extracting, ready, failed, needs-whisper) and files that couldn't be read, knowledge-graph topics with fact counts, deadlines (kind, date, time, done, files each covers), path (each topic's status, what the next covers), lessons, today's local date and time. files: true lists every file instead (id, kind, status, size, path on disk). To find something inside files: search_space_files.

files.description: List every file with its id (needed for file_ids). Default false.

name: search_space_files
title: Search a space's files
description: Search all of a space's files (readings, slides, transcripts, syllabus, assignments) by meaning and keywords. Returns best passages, each with id, file, place (page, slide, time or lines) and short snippet. Open needed ones with read_passage, not whole files.

query.description: What to look for, in plain words.

name: read_passage
title: Read a passage of a space file
description: Read one passage of a space file by its id from search_space_files, or a file's passages at a place (file_id + range, e.g. a whole page). Returns text with ids of passages before and after, to keep reading.

passage_id.description: A passage id from search_space_files (or a previous/next id).

file_id.description: Instead of passage_id: a file id from read_space, with range.

range.description: With file_id: the place, e.g. "p. 12", "slide 4", "section 3", "12:30" or "lines 40".

name: create_space
title: Create a space
description: Create a space for one thing the learner studies (university course, certification, language). Description is shown to the teacher in every lesson of the space: level, book or source they follow, its notation, what they work toward (a course's exams, an interview). Add deadlines with add_space_deadline. A goal with no syllabus (a job, a skill): send path, the topics toward it in order, leaving out what the learner already knows.

name.description: The space's name, e.g. "MATH 20C – Calculus III" or "Conversational Spanish".

description.description: What the teacher should know about the space, in the learner's terms.

signature.description: Space's signature: ONE line summing up the subject, shown huge on the space's cover. kind "math" = LaTeX without $ (math, physics, chemistry, economics), "code" = a line of code (programming spaces), "text" = anything else (a line from a primary source, a sequence, a date). Max 60 characters. Pick something iconic; ask the learner when unsure.

icon.description: Space's subject icon in the space switcher: "cpu" Computer science, "code" Programming, "sigma" Math, "chart-line" Statistics, "atom" Physics, "flask-conical" Chemistry, "dna" Biology, "brain" Psychology, "landmark" History, "scale" Law and politics, "trending-up" Economics, "globe" Geography, "languages" Languages, "book-open" Literature, "palette" Art, "music" Music. Pick the closest subject.

path.description: Topics toward a goal with no syllabus, in order, in your own words. Sending it replaces the list; a topic keeps its progress while its name stays.

goal.description: What the learner works toward, read after "Path to", e.g. "backend developer".

covers.description: One line on what the topic covers.

name: update_space
title: Update a space
description: Rename a space, change description, signature, icon or path, or close / reopen it (closing hides its tab, keeps everything; closed space takes no new lessons).

signature.description: Space's signature: ONE line summing up the subject, shown huge on the space's cover. kind "math" = LaTeX without $ (math, physics, chemistry, economics), "code" = a line of code (programming spaces), "text" = anything else (a line from a primary source, a sequence, a date). Max 60 characters. Pick something iconic; ask the learner when unsure.

icon.description: Space's subject icon in the space switcher: "cpu" Computer science, "code" Programming, "sigma" Math, "chart-line" Statistics, "atom" Physics, "flask-conical" Chemistry, "dna" Biology, "brain" Psychology, "landmark" History, "scale" Law and politics, "trending-up" Economics, "globe" Geography, "languages" Languages, "book-open" Literature, "palette" Art, "music" Music. Pick the closest subject.

path.description: Topics toward a goal with no syllabus, in order, in your own words. Sending it replaces the list; a topic keeps its progress while its name stays.

goal.description: What the learner works toward, read after "Path to", e.g. "backend developer".

covers.description: One line on what the topic covers.

name: add_space_file
title: Add a file to a space
description: Copy a file from this computer into a space, or write one with name and text instead of path (one you wrote before by that name is replaced, keeps its id). Supported: .md .txt, code files (.c .py .java .js and the like), plain text with no extension, .pdf .docx .pptx .epub, .vtt .srt (transcripts) and .mp3 .m4a .wav .mp4 .mov (recordings, transcribed locally with whisper.cpp). Google Docs links (.gdoc) need saving as PDF or Word first. Study files are turned into facts by you, through wait_for_work.

name.description: Instead of path: the new file's name, e.g. "Study guide.md".

text.description: With name: its text, in Markdown, up to 20,000 characters.

kind.description: "study" = study material turned into graph facts (notes, readings, transcripts, recordings); "info" = space info the teacher can read, never facts (syllabus, schedule, logistics).

name: set_space_file_kind
title: Set space files' kind
description: Switch space files between study material and space info. Study → info removes their facts; info → study builds them. File that can't switch is listed under refused; others still switch.

file_ids.description: The files to switch (ids from read_space with files: true).

kind.description: "study" = study material turned into graph facts (notes, readings, transcripts, recordings); "info" = space info the teacher can read, never facts (syllabus, schedule, logistics).

name: add_space_deadline
title: Add deadlines to a space
description: Add one or more deadlines to a space (all of a space's deadlines in one call): exams, homework, quizzes, projects, interviews, each with date, time if any, and which space files (notes, readings) it covers. godspeed uses it to show the learner what's due and what to work on first. Take deadlines, dates and times from space info files (syllabus, schedule); never make up a date or time. Work out coverage from the space's own files first: practice exam or review sheet, schedule, announcements (search_space_files). Link files they point to (file_ids), list earlier files it doesn't cover in left_out_ids, name in source the file it came from. Ask only when files don't settle it. File ids from read_space with files: true. Refused deadlines are listed under refused with the reason; others still get added, so resend only refused ones. Interview: add the posting as space info, the interview with date and time, What it's like.md as about_file_id, and a Study guide.md you write (study) in file_ids.

time.description: Due time as 24-hour "HH:MM" on this computer's clock. Omit when none (then due at end of day).

file_ids.description: Ids of the space files it covers.

left_out_ids.description: Ids of earlier space files it does NOT cover (e.g. lectures after the practice exam's last topic). Learner's page stops flagging them as missing.

source.description: Where you found what it covers, e.g. the practice exam's file name. Learner sees it.

assignment_file_id.description: Homework and projects: id of the space file with its problems (assignment sheet). Learner works on its problems in godspeed.

about_file_id.description: Exams, quizzes, interviews: id of a space info file on what it's like ("What it's like.md", written with add_space_file). Search space files and the web first; under 200 words; name only sources you read.

name: update_space_deadline
title: Update a space deadline
description: Change a deadline's kind, name, date, time, covered files, left-out files, source, assignment file or about file, or tick done (done: true) / not done (done: false). file_ids and left_out_ids each replace the whole list (a file is never in both); time: null, source: null, assignment_file_id: null and about_file_id: null remove them. Work out coverage from space's own files as add_space_deadline says; ask the learner when files don't settle it.

time.description: 24-hour "HH:MM", or null to remove the time.

file_ids.description: Ids of the space files it covers.

left_out_ids.description: Ids of earlier space files it does NOT cover (e.g. lectures after the practice exam's last topic). Learner's page stops flagging them as missing.

source.description: Where you found what it covers, e.g. the practice exam's file name. Learner sees it.

assignment_file_id.description: Homework and projects: id of the space file with its problems (assignment sheet). Learner works on its problems in godspeed.

about_file_id.description: Id of the space info file on what it's like (see add_space_deadline), or null to remove it.

name: remove_space_deadline
title: Remove a space deadline
description: Remove one deadline from a space (its files and facts untouched).

name: link_space_folder
title: Link a folder to a space
description: Link a folder on this computer to a space. Supported files are added; from then on new files dropped there are added automatically and edited ones rebuilt (checked every minute while godspeed is open). godspeed sorts them into study material and space info itself while reading, never changes the folder. set_space_file_kind only to correct a kind.

name: start_lesson
title: Start or continue a lesson
description: Start or continue a study session in godspeed taught by you. topic: a new session; it becomes the learner's first message and the lesson's title in their top bar, so plain words, never file ids, paths or quoted file names; a path topic's name studies that topic. deadline_id alone: what the deadline's Study key does (continues the unfinished session for it the learner last worked in, else starts one on its topics); with homework: true, its Work on key (continues its latest homework session, else starts one). topic with deadline_id: a new session for that deadline that is not its Study session, like a practice test the learner gave you. With space_id the lesson belongs to that space: opens with the space's card, its facts go to that space's graph. You teach it through wait_for_work; learner follows in the godspeed window.

topic.description: What the learner wants to study, in their words.

space_id.description: The space id from list_spaces, or "none" for lessons without a space (the default).

deadline_id.description: A deadline's id from read_space. Alone: its Study key. With topic: the new session is for that deadline.

homework.description: With deadline_id: true only when the learner asks to do its problems ("work on HW6"). Studying, learning or reviewing it ("continue my HW6 study") leaves it out.

name: open_page
title: Open a page
description: Open a page in the learner's godspeed window when they ask to see something ("open my cheat sheet"), even with Follow off; brings the window forward. Never jumps away from unsent lesson text, a running mock or an open dialog: then the window offers Go to instead.

page.description: home, a space's progress, files, deadlines or graph, a deadline, its cheat_sheet, or a lesson.

space_id.description: With progress, files, deadlines or graph: the space id from list_spaces, or "none" for no space (not for files or deadlines).

deadline_id.description: With deadline or cheat_sheet: the deadline's id from read_space.

lesson_id.description: With lesson: the lesson's id from list_lessons.

name: unlink_space_folder
title: Unlink a space's folder
description: Unlink the space's folder: its files leave the space with their facts. Folder itself untouched.
